title: GovCoreCheckpointAndRecoveryState
description: Checkpoint adapter snapshot + interrupt/retry metadata. JSON file checkpoints under runtime/checkpoints/ remain governed by Departments README (not this schema).

attempt.description: 1-based attempt; maps to retry_count as attempt - 1 when retry_count is used in traces.

checkpoint_key.description: LangGraph thread / checkpoint id when available.

interrupt_reason.description: Human-readable reason when graph interrupted or stopped early.
